secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo access — used to inspect repositories and commit changes. Optional for boot; required for the agent pipeline to function.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key — one of the optional AI provider keys. At least one provider key is needed for the agents to run.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key — optional AI provider key.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key — optional AI provider key.

secrets.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
secrets.description: Mistral API key — optional AI provider key.

secrets.name: HF_API_KEY
secrets.description: Hugging Face API key — optional AI provider key.
